title: Emerald Lace and Garters
reference_source: Серия в кружевном белье — гламурный будуарный регистр
mood_ru: Винтажный туалетный столик, лампы у зеркала. Изумруд — канон-палитра персоны.
allure: lace lingerie editorial glamour, delicate lace set with full opaque lining, sculpted waist and long legs, soft boudoir light gliding over the lace, assured sensual gaze, emerald lace with garter straps and sheer stockings, deep jewel colour against her skin

wardrobe.notes_ru: Изумрудное кружево с подкладкой, пояс для чулок, чулки. Канон-палитра.
wardrobe.prompt: deep emerald green lace lingerie set with full opaque lining, matching emerald garter belt with straps, sheer black stockings, silver star pendant, hair pinned up with loose strands, bare feet

location.notes_ru: Винтажный будуар, туалетный столик с лампами, бархат, латунь.
location.prompt: vintage boudoir, wooden vanity table with warm bulbs framing the mirror, velvet stool, crystal perfume bottles, brass jewellery tray, patterned wallpaper, heavy drapes, dim warm room

shots.pose: sitting on the velvet vanity stool with one heel up on the edge, fastening the garter strap to the stocking top, back arched, head turned up to the lens mid-motion
shots.camera: 50mm lens, eye level, side three-quarter angle, full body framing
shots.light: warm bulb lights around the mirror throwing even glow on her skin, dim room behind

shots.pose: standing at the vanity with her back to the camera in the emerald set, one hand on the table, back arched, meeting the lens through her own reflection in the mirror
shots.camera: 35mm lens, eye level, back view into the mirror, full body framing
shots.light: mirror bulbs frontal on her face in the reflection, warm rim along her bare back

shots.pose: kneeling back on her heels on the velvet chaise beside the vanity, spine deeply arched, one hand planted beside her, head turned over the shoulder holding direct eye contact with the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, slightly above eye level, back three-quarter angle, full body vertical framing
shots.light: warm vanity bulbs wrapping her face and shoulders, a single brass lamp glow along her back

shots.pose: standing close to the bulb-framed vanity mirror, one hand resting on the surface, hip pushed out, chin lowered, holding her own gaze while the camera catches her and the reflection at once
shots.camera: 50mm lens, eye level, over-the-shoulder into the reflection, thigh-up framing
shots.light: warm vanity bulbs wrapping her face and shoulders, a single brass lamp glow along her back

shots.pose: standing at the narrow draped window with one forearm raised against the frame, weight settled on one hip, back to the camera, long line of the spine on show, looking away into the light
shots.camera: 35mm lens, eye level, back view, full body vertical framing
shots.light: warm vanity bulbs wrapping her face and shoulders, a single brass lamp glow along her back

shots.pose: reclining back on the velvet chaise beside the vanity propped on both elbows, one knee raised and the other leg stretched long, ribcage lifted, chin up, half-lidded gaze straight down the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, low camera at surface level, three-quarter front angle, full body framing
shots.light: warm vanity bulbs wrapping her face and shoulders, a single brass lamp glow along her back

shots.pose: cropped detail composition of the garter strap clipped to the stocking top against her thigh, face out of frame, fingers relaxed and naturally posed
shots.camera: 85mm lens, close detail framing, very shallow depth of field
shots.light: warm vanity bulbs wrapping her face and shoulders, a single brass lamp glow along her back

shots.pose: lying on her back on the velvet chaise beside the vanity, one arm thrown above her head, the other hand resting on her waist, hair fanned out, knees softly bent, eyes lifted to the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, directly overhead top-down angle, full body framing
shots.light: warm vanity bulbs wrapping her face and shoulders, a single brass lamp glow along her back

shots.pose: standing tall beside the vanity in the warm bulb light, one hand pushing back through her hair with the elbow raised, weight shifted onto one leg so the hip breaks the line, chin down and eyes up into the lens
shots.camera: 50mm lens, slightly low angle, frontal, full body framing
shots.light: warm vanity bulbs wrapping her face and shoulders, a single brass lamp glow along her back

shots.pose: seen small across the space across the dim vintage boudoir, caught mid-movement and not looking at the camera, the room itself carrying the mood
shots.camera: 24mm wide lens, eye level, wide environmental full-body shot
shots.light: warm vanity bulbs wrapping her face and shoulders, a single brass lamp glow along her back
